title: Countable uniformly dense family of test functions supported in a compact set
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [SecondCountableTopology X] (K : Set X), IsCompact K → ∃ D : Set C_c(X, ℝ), D.Countable ∧ (∀ g ∈ D, tsupport g ⊆ K) ∧ ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ K → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ g ∈ D, ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ ε
